utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. Just let me know if you hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Eli — if I hear anything new while I’m out, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the repair drive for, and when is it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s to fix up a few things around the block — mostly small repairs and cleanup. I’ll send the time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — send me the time when you know it, and I’ll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening — I just want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm the drop-off time and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I can help, I just need to remember what day we said it was on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s this Saturday afternoon at the community shed. I’ve got the supplies list if you want me to read it off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes—Saturday afternoon at the community shed. Please read me the supplies list so I don’t forget again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs repairing and what the drive is for? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, right — it’s for fixing up the broken stuff around the neighborhood, like that leaky pipe and the loose fence panels. I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact list, but it’s just to get everything working again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll keep it general for now and wait for the exact list before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane — we’re still on track. I’ve got the list here, and I’m just waiting on a couple more confirmations before we start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help once those confirmations come in. Want me to check in with anyone?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and set aside anything that still works? I can bring over a few bins and labels.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. Bring the bins and labels over, and I’ll start sorting the tools as soon as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where exactly is the repair drive being held?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s at the school parking lot by the gym this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — the school parking lot by the gym this Saturday morning. I’ll head there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout already—folks are dropping off tools and a few spare parts too. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess—thank you. If you hear anything specific they still need, please let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do—I'll ask around and let you know if they’re short on anything specific. Seems like the drive’s off to a promising start!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you still taking repair requests for the drive, or are you just collecting parts now?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still taking repair requests — I’m just sorting parts as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to know — can I still drop off the broken lamp and fan, or should I wait for a parts list?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by the repair drive and see what they need. If you hear anything else, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep my ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll check in at the repair drive and keep people posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive organized and ready, Uli—just tell me what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. The porch step is the first thing that really needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll put the porch step at the top of the list and make sure we handle it first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up steam—folks are dropping off tools and a few donations already.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. I’ll stop by tomorrow morning with my old drill and a couple of wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Eli—I'm sure they’ll put them to good use. I’ll let you know if they need anything else before then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we still need to sort the donation boxes, check the tool list, and line up a few volunteers for the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can take the donation boxes and help check the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help if you need it—what’s still left to fix for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just the front gate and the loose step, really. I’d appreciate the help, if you’ve got the time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with those. When do you want to tackle the gate and step?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just a quick headcount and the best drop-off spot for the donations. If you have a preferred location, I can work it into the plan.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can give you a headcount by tomorrow, and the front porch drop-off spot works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—do you want me to spread the word or coordinate anything?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you spread the word for now? If you can, please also let me know who’s interested so I can coordinate the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and send you a list of anyone interested as they reach out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’ve got a few more volunteers lined up, and I’m checking which tools we still need. I’ll update you as soon as I know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — thanks, Mara. Just let me know what tools are missing when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—how’s it going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s going steady so far—folks are still dropping by with broken bits and we’re getting them sorted out. If you need a tool or a hand, I can lend one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear—thanks, Gus. I might swing by later if I need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—could you help sort the donations and load the boxes this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can sort the donations and help load the boxes this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re planning to start Saturday morning, and the drop-off is at the community hall on Maple. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning works for me, but what time should I be there? Also, do you need me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—want me to put your name down too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, put me down too—I can help keep track of supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—thanks, Cleo. I’ll add your name and let you know what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still pinning that down, but I should have the time sorted out soon. I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — just send me the time when you have it and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll start organizing the repair drive and keep everyone in the loop. If you’d like, I can help make a simple list of what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, Rosa — I’d love a simple first list so I can keep up with what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll make a simple first list and share it with you soon.
